verdict.rationale: ELSTER exposes a sanctioned third-party software channel ("any tax software that supports ELSTER"), so a versioned-API and deprecation-policy question is a fair one to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning, version lifecycles, or any documented deprecation policy for that interface. The ERiC artifact probe only shows the host was unreachable, which says nothing about versioning, so the capability is unevidenced.
